chapters.reason: The paper introduces Certaindex to dynamically scale compute during inference by detecting answer stabilization, enabling early exit and dynamic token allocation, which aligns with efficient test-time scaling via confidence-based methods and balancing search depth/width.

The work integrates Certaindex into Dynasor, a reasoning-aware LLM serving system, demonstrating practical applications in real-world systems with compute savings and throughput improvements, matching the focus on efficient reasoning applications like early exit strategies and dynamic query routing.

Certaindex is introduced as a metric to quantify answer stabilization and overthinking, contributing to evaluation benchmarks that measure reasoning efficiency and trade-offs between accuracy and token consumption, though it is not the primary focus.
